installed_collection.diagnostic_note: build_release.py preserves the first diagnostic packaging attempt; build_release_v2.py is the successful follow-up. Launch metadata precedes final browser shutdown.
installed_collection.counting_note: Installed pytest cases and HTTP assertions qualify the artifact separately; neither is added to the 525 unique source cases.

diagnostics: Initial helper exact numeric accessible name stopped matching after the modified badge appeared; fixed the locator and reran.
Second helper expected All changes saved after save; actual confirmation is Settings saved and applied.; fixed wait and reran.
Third helper had no explicit original viewport in headed mode; all assertions/screenshots completed but viewport restoration failed. Added an explicit fallback and reran successfully.
First attempt to open the header menu was blocked by the first-run metrics opt-in panel. Closed it without opting in.

shutdown.windows_diagnostic: Get-NetTCPConnection briefly retained Listen records with OwningProcess=0 after both known processes exited; the TCP probe could not connect.

browser_collection.diagnostic_note: Original failed helper attempts and diagnostic snapshots are preserved. Their recorded locator/wait/viewport failures required helper-only corrections.
browser_collection.visual_review: Parent agent inspected the three PNGs; collection verifies hashes and recorded outcomes.
browser_collection.shutdown_interpretation: Canonical DRAINED; both known processes absent; probe returned 10035 and did not connect. No claim of connection-refused. Transient Windows Listen PID0 records are recorded in the original JSON.
browser_collection.counting_note: Browser controls and actions are not pytest cases and do not change source acceptance counts.
